description: A direction ablated at every layer in one entry: each layer's mean residual stream at the prompts' last token (`direction`, one vector per layer, its layers axis labelled 0 to 4) is projected out of every token's residual stream at every layer, `layers: ":"`. At layer L the write takes the direction's slice labelled L, in one forward, so the one entry is the five entries of one layer each that it replaces, to the bit (test_layers.py runs both). After its edit the entry scores what each layer's stream keeps along its own direction (`cosine`, zero to within rounding), so its value has the layers axis first. The logit difference before and after is saved.
